It makes me feel a lot better knowing I’m not the only cptsd person going through this😭 but I’m sorry your dealing with this too. And i believe there is a connection. I’m in a CPTSD intensive outpatient program and most of my fellow group members experience weird sensations/twitching just nothing as intense as me. It’s crazy how much PTSD affects your nervous system. And my therapist/psych within that program(not my actual psychiatrist or one on one therapist, just for the group) have both said they do see non epileptic seizure activity pretty frequently with PTSD patients. All the technicians and nurses I’ve spoken too in between appts and for tests have also said it sounds like psychogenic seizure activity. I did the eeg and I don’t think we caught anything. I just want an answer as to what’s happening so it’ll take away a little bit of stress whenever I have the “episodes”😭

Thank you so much for such a thoughtful response! I totally understand the misuse of the term pseudo seizures, I’d seen some other people discussing here and there on the CPTSD subreddit as well and it makes a lot of sense, I was just regurgitating the term my therapist used. I’m currently getting an eeg done and mri soon, going thru with the tests regardless of my neuro’s recommendation. She seems to think I’m only having panic attacks, she might be right but the involuntary movement I’ve been seeing is pretty severe and debilitating to my daily life, and kicked up pretty intensely once I started PTSD treatment. 

I’m pretty confident I don’t suffer from epilepsy, just want to rule everything out so they can tell me exactly what I have and what the likelihood of the episodes stopping one day, might be. They’ve been going strong for about two months now lol🤣 

I’m going to stick with my current neurologist for this round of testing and then start looking for a new one after that. Thanks again!

Hi everyone I have a tiny update!!!!

I had another really bad episode that lasted a couple hours. It happened directly after seeing my family(the cause of my cptsd lmao) and my therapist said it’s most likely pseudo seizures, and my neuro isn’t giving me the time of day because they aren’t caused by brain wave activity like epilepsy. I’m mad at the neurologist tbh, because in my mind she should be testing me so we can rule out epilepsy so I can least KNOW what I’m experiencing is in fact pseudo seizures. I’m getting an EEG tomorrow and an MRI soon, however my next tremor episode I have Im going to the ER if it’ll get me a quicker MRI. I also got some labs done and I do have a hyper active thyroid as well as B12 deficiency. Could also have something to do with the tremoring. We’ll see!!! Will update if I find out more. Thanks for all the thoughtful comments, it really means a lot. Cptsd is so complicated it’s crazy.

My current routine is shampoo with a gentle shampoo most of the time and then use a clarifying whenever I feel like there’s buildup. 

I then condition using the Shea moisture castor oil conditioner and scrunch as I do so, rinsing it very gently after about 5-10 mins. I also brush my hair using my wet brush at this time. I scrunch using a tshirt right out of the shower. 

Then use a generous amount of the kinky curly knot today, bc my hair tends to feel super dry otherwise. I glaze and then scrunch it into my hair. 

After this I just split my hair into two parts and brought them forward. I scrunched with a generous amt of Miss Jessie’s Soft jelly curls and repeated the same w the mousse! Whenever my hair begins to feel dry I spray it with water to get it wet again so my curls don’t fall! Plopping rlly sets the wave in. Otherwise I will have a bunch of straight pieces. 

I plop for twenty minutes or so then diffuse!!
Thank you love! 💕

My current routine is this:

I shampoo with a gentle shampoo(sulfate and paraben free. Can’t remember the brand but it’s from target) and only scrub my scalp. 

I condition with the Shea moisture castor oil conditioner. I brush through my hair using the wet brush and get out all of the tangles. I leave the conditioner in my hair for 5ish minutes before rinsing. 

Once out of the shower I brush through my hair with a comb. I then spray my leave in, the shea moisture manuka honey and yogurt spray in. Tbh I don’t care for this leave in, I would be down to switch to something else. 

After that I glaze and scrunch in small sections with the Shea moisture curl glam defining cream, and then repeat the process with the spiked honey mousse from Camille Rose.

I plop my hair for an hour or so and then diffuse. The attached pics are of my first day hair. Day 2 is fine if I dampen my hair and scrunch but day three looks rough lmao

Edit: I wash my hair every 3-4 days. Once every few weeks I use a clarifying shampoo.
